column1: # XML paired samples Usage002_03/04: MatchedTokenParser candidates come from the current token stack (#1016, #1017).
# Every close reads the TagIdentifier names on the current parse path again, in the order of xml-tags.tsv.
#   Names of an earlier close, of an earlier use of the same parser instance and of a rolled-back
#   alternative are not kept; a list kept for the whole parse (the Java behaviour before #1017) fails here.
# Model as in xml-tags.tsv; derived by hand and checked against the Java samples. Cells as in xml-tags.tsv.
# shared: the class-factory instance of NoMixedContentsXmlElementsPaired is the root, the same instance as
# every nested level. retry: Choice(Chain(shared, "!"), Chain("", shared)).
# second: the second alternative of retry alone. twice: Chain(shared, shared), the same instance twice.
